neighbours.label: A lone capital ' F' or ' L' token that begins a proper name the tokenizer splits after its first letter (L|ysander, F|okker, F|arnsworth), vs proper names that are whole tokens or split elsewhere
fire: The explorer Frobisher sailed north in search of a passage to Asia.
The inventor Farnsworth demonstrated an early electronic television.
We bought a bottle of Lysol to clean the kitchen after the party.
The old general Lysander won the final naval battle of the war.
Her grandfather flew a Fokker in the last months of the war.
The ferry from Lanzarote arrived late because of strong winds.
The university in Laramie hosted the regional chess tournament.
The critics praised Fassbinder for his bleak portraits of postwar life.

predictions: Fire items 0.13-0.4 on the ' F' or ' L' token; names that are whole tokens or split differently under 0.05.
